design: 4 frozen tasks x skill absent/present x High/Low x 2 independent repetitions; adjacent four-arm blocks, randomized first order and reversed second order per task
limitations: Frozen tasks reused; this is an intervention/effort study, not a new-task generalization test.
Skill effect includes installation, discovery and loading with an identical conditional invocation prompt, not just the 94-character body.
Cache warmth is not controllable; report uncached, cached and output components separately.
A fixed-budget descriptive study; no power calculation or universal quality claim.
No global setting change; single-turn desktop-bundled headless engine, not GUI or production validation.
accounting: All committed assistant request usages; cached input, uncached input and output reported separately. No title usage or unknown in-flight usage is fabricated. No monetary claim.

host.version_observation: Package manifests checked after this batch; executable path shared by all runs. Binary was not snapshot-pinned. Previous experiments recorded rc.2 and are not pooled.

provenance: Sanitized local observations, with exact raw session archives retained privately. Public hashes identify retained archives but do not independently verify original usage.

profile_control.note: Private patch contents compared locally; credentials and machine paths are not published.
